Name: DE-Projects
Statement:
-- +ASSIGNMENTS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Project)
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Project)
with 
est as
(
    select  Project,
            sum(ValueWithoutVatCost) as ValueWithoutTaxCost,
            sum(VatValueCost) as TaxValueCost,
            sum(ValueWithVatCost) as ValueWithTaxCost,
            sum(ValueWithoutVatIncome) as ValueWithoutTaxSell,
            sum(VatValueIncome) as TaxValueSell,
            sum(ValueWithVatIncome) as ValueWithTaxSell
    from    Estimate est, WorkflowState wfs, WorkflowStateType wst
    where   est.Project is not null and
            wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState and
            wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType and
            wst.Name not in ('Draft', 'Canceled')
    group by Project
),
cut as
(
    select  a.DocumentOid as Id,
            max(isnull(convert(int, wsat.AllowPending), 0)) as AllowPending
    from    Assignment a  
                join Projectlookup prj on prj.Id = a.DocumentOid 
                left join WorkflowStateAssignmentType wsat on wsat.AssignmentType = a.AssignmentType and wsat.WorkflowState = prj.WorkflowState
    where   a.DocumentTypeName = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Project' and 
            a.[User] = @CurrentUserId
    group by a.DocumentOid
),
dld as
(
    select  Project,
            max(datediff(day, cast(getdate() as date), job.AgreedDateUtc)) as Delayed
    from    JobLookup job
                join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = job.WorkflowState
    where   wfs.Delayed = 1 and
            job.AgreedDateUtc < cast(getdate() as date)
    group by Project
)
select  prj.Oid as DocumentOid,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company,
        com.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        cli.Id as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cli.HasImage as ClientHasImage,
        cnt.Id as ContractId,
        cnt.Name as Contract,
        cnt.Number as ContractNumber,
        prj.Oid as ProjectId,
        prj.Name as Project,
        prj.Number as ProjectNumber,
        prj.BeginDate as StartDate,
        prj.EndDate,
        prj.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        brd.Oid as BrandId,
        brd.Name as Brand,
        pro.Oid as ProductId,
        pro.Name as Product,
        cls.Oid as ClassificationId,
        cls.Name as Classification,
        nat.Oid as NatureId,
        nat.Name as Nature,
        wfs.Oid as StageId,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        wfs.Color as StageColor,
        wst.Oid as StageTypeId,
        wst.Name as StageType,
        wst.Color as StageTypeColor,
        cur.Oid as CurrencyId,
        cur.Name as Currency,
        prj.Investment,
        own.Id as OwnerId,
        own.Name as Owner,
        own.HasImage as OwnerHasImage,
        owc.Id as OwnerCompanyId,
        owc.Name as OwnerCompany,
        owc.HasImage as OwnerCompanyHasImage,
        iif(prj.ProjectType = 1, 'Isolated', 'Contract') as ProjectType,
        rtc.Name as RateCard,
        rcc.Name as RateCardColumn,
        isnull(est.ValueWithoutTaxCost, 0) as EstimatedWithoutTaxCost,
        isnull(est.TaxValueCost, 0) as EstimatedTaxCost,
        isnull(est.ValueWithTaxCost, 0) as EstimatedWithTaxCost,
        isnull(est.ValueWithoutTaxSell, 0) as EstimatedWithoutTaxSell,
        isnull(est.TaxValueSell, 0) as EstimatedTaxSell,
        isnull(est.ValueWithTaxSell, 0) as EstimatedWithTaxSell,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        cre.Name as CreatedBy,
        cre.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        mod.Id as ModifiedId,
        mod.Name as ModifiedBy,
        mod.HasImage as ModifiedHasImage,
        iif(bor.Oid is not null, 1, 0) as AlreadyRead,
        iif(cut.Id is null, 0, 1) as CurrentUserInTeam,
        iif(cut.AllowPending is null, 0, cut.AllowPending) as CurrentUserPending,
        iif(dld.Delayed is not null, 1, 0) as IsDelayed,
        dld.Delayed
from    Project prj
            join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = prj.CreatedBy
            join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = prj.ModifiedBy
            left join UserLookup own on own.Id = prj.ProjectOwner
            left join CompanyLookup owc on owc.Id = own.Company
            left join ContractLookup cnt on cnt.Id = prj.Contract
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = prj.Company
            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = prj.Client
            left join CommercialClientProduct pro on pro.Oid = prj.Product
            left join Brand brd on brd.Oid = pro.Brand
            left join ProjectClassification cls on cls.Oid = prj.Classification 
            join ProjectNature nat on nat.Oid = prj.ProjectNature
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = prj.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            left join Currency cur on cur.Oid = prj.Currency
            left join est on est.Project = prj.Oid
            left join RateCard rtc on rtc.Oid = prj.RateCard
            left join RateCardColumn rcc on rcc.Oid = prj.RateCardColumn
            left join cut on cut.Id = prj.Oid
            left join BaseObjectRead bor on bor.ObjectId = prj.Oid and bor.ObjectType = 'Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Project' and bor.[User] = @CurrentUserId
            left join dld on dld.Project = prj.Oid
